treatment_plan.definitive: 3 It is recommended to plant immediately after pulling out.
treatment_plan.notes: Follow-up for discomfort. Ask for follow-up consultation if you feel unwell. Bite a cotton roll for 40 minutes. Do not brush your teeth or rinse your mouth for 24 hours. You can eat and drink after 2 hours. It is recommended that the food should not be too hot.

source_handle: 3. Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local iodophor disinfection, local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine, anesthesia injection, blood pressure after extraction of the tooth was high, 180/80, sublingual administration of 0.25 mg nitroglycerin tablets, suturing to stop bleeding, and rescheduling for implantation date.
